## Opening
## Attacking

Fairly common type of middle game position with attacking potential. Left, about the minimal strength that *White* would need to double; right, a variation that gives *Black* a minimal take. 

Note the two significant changes: White got another powerful builder, Black moved a pip back so he can't as easily anchor the 22-point. 

:::: {layout-ncol=2 .column-body-outset}

::: {}
**Minimal double**

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
id <- "XGID=-a-a-CCBC---cC---c-c-bb-A-:0:0:1:00:0:0:0:0:10"
ggboard(id)
```

<details><summary>Analysis</summary>

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_cube(id, plies = 2, trials = 5 * 1296)
```

</details>
:::
